basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Siemens Industry

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
2006 to 2011	Participated on a team that developed a complex, full-featured tool for specifying, collecting and graphing of data from CNC/PLC/HMI sources.  The product was reengineered from a Windows based engineering system to an embedded control system.  The product is built within a C++ framework based on Qt, XML, and a Siemens proprietary GUI framework.  Also wrote additional UI tools, including a feature for editing SINAMICS Data Set blocks (motor/drive/encoder control parameters). Developed a testing tool built upon the Qt framework.  Applied UML, Enterprise Architect, and Scrum principles.  Projects were coordinated with colleagues in Erlangen Germany.

2000 to 2005	Developed firmware ("C" and C165 assembler) for a Siemens Profibus PCI card (dual C165 and ASPC2 processors) using cross platform development, Tasking tools, and Infineon Hitex debugger.  Established build/test/debug/emulate environment (Tanto ICE, Tasking/Hitex tools) for Siemens SoftPLC, a Windows/x86 software PLC that emulates a Siemens PLC-317 containing a TriCore IBC32 DSP/RISC microcontroller.  Developed test suites for SoftPLC using existing Siemens PLC testing tools and methods (PST_IP, K95, and others).  Developed a Windows 2000/XP driver for Siemens dual port Profibus-DP PCI card.  This product enabled the customer's PC-based Soft CNC application to communicate with Siemens 611U digital drives and I/O.

experience.title: Technical Support Engineer
experience.description: Participated in the opening of Advantech's Midwest Sales and Support Center. Provided technical support and sales/customer support for Advantech's Industrial Automation products: PLCs, industrial PCs, embedded single board computers, remote I/O modules, data acquisition modules, flat panel displays, and peripherals.  Performed remote troubleshooting and in-house diagnosis/repair.  Provided technical assistance to sales staff.

experience.title: Systems Software Engineer
experience.description: Wrote 100% of firmware for multi-loop PID process control servo board for Injection Molding. Full responsibility (design thru test) of system software/firmware for multiple Plastics Controller products. Performed all tasks required for the specification, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and maintenance of software systems for various real-time programmable controller products.  Heavy use of PL/M, "C" and 80x86 assembly language.  Some use of Pascal, Visual Basic, and C++.  Experience with PLC operating systems, servo control, serial drivers, operator interfaces, TSRs, compiler/interpreter development, vxWorks, I/O communication, some Windows programming.  Extensive experience with hardware chip-level systems programming using high level languages and assembly language for time critical tasks.
